####################################################################################################
Purpose of script: To check the model results and plot it 
####################################################################################################

```{r}
rm(list = ls())
source("../00_pck.R")
source("../00_dirs.R")
theme_set(theme_classic() + theme(strip.background = element_blank()))
```

# Define main analyses 
```{r}
pat_sel <- c("rota", "hav", "hbv", "dipht", "tetan", "pertuwpt", "ipv1", 
             "hib", "menc", "strep04", "measl", "mumps", "rubel", "vzv")
```

# Read in data 
```{r}
# Read best model
waic_best <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$outputs}/modres/all_waicbest.rds"))
waiccomb_best <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$modres}/all_waiccombbest.rds"))
waic_best_all <- bind_rows(waiccomb_best, waic_best)

# Read in data gaps
all_datagaps <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$modres}/all_datagaps.rds")) 
all_datagapssim <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$modres}/all_datagapssim.rds")) 

all_samplescosine <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$modres}/all_samplescosine.rds")) %>%
  left_join(all_datagapssim, by = join_by(pat, mod, reg, clu, dat))
```

# Select only main analyses
```{r}
sel_samplescosine <- all_samplescosine %>%
  filter(is.na(included) | included == TRUE) %>%
  # Take best models from main analyses that have latitudinal change
  filter(mod %in% waic_best$mod_best, dat == "s08", pat %in% pat_sel)
```

# Mean amplitude 
```{r}
sel_samplescosine %>%
  distinct(mod, pat, reg, clu, amp_mean, phi_mean) %>%
  #arrange(phi_mean)
  summarise(mean_amp_mean = round(mean(amp_mean*100), digits = 3),
            min_amp_mean = round(min(amp_mean*100), digits = 3),
            max_amp_mean = round(max(amp_mean*100), digits = 3))

sel_samplescosine %>%
  distinct(mod, pat, reg, clu, amp_mean, phi_mean) %>%
  group_by(clu) %>%
  mutate(phi_mean = circular::circular(phi_mean * ((2*pi)/52), units = "radians", modulo = "2pi")) %>%
  summarise(phi_mean = as.numeric(mean(phi_mean)),
            phi_mean_week = (phi_mean*52) / (2*pi))
```

# Compare amplitudes 
```{r}
test <- sel_samplescosine %>%
  filter(!is.na(reg)) %>%
  select(sam_no, pat, mod, clu, sam_amp) %>%
  mutate(sam_amp = sam_amp * 100) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = clu, values_from = sam_amp, names_prefix = "clu_") %>%
  mutate(diff = clu_2_Subtropical - clu_3_Tropical,
         diff_rel = clu_2_Subtropical/clu_3_Tropical*100)

test %>%
  group_by(pat, mod) %>%
  summarise(sum_mean = mean(diff),
            sum_qlo = quantile(diff, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
            sum_qup = quantile(diff, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
            sum_mean_rel = mean(diff_rel),
            sum_qlo_rel = quantile(diff_rel, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
            sum_qup_rel = quantile(diff_rel, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("sum"), round, digits = 2))
```

# Compare phases 
```{r}
test %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = diff)) +
  geom_histogram() +
  facet_wrap(~pat)

test <- sel_samplescosine %>%
  filter(!is.na(reg)) %>%
  select(sam_no, pat, mod, clu, sam_phi) %>%
  # convert from weeks (0–52) to radians
  mutate(sam_phi_rad = sam_phi * (2 * pi / 52)) %>%
  select(-sam_phi) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = clu, values_from = sam_phi_rad, names_prefix = "clu_") %>%
  # raw difference in radians
  mutate(
    diff_raw = clu_3_Tropical - clu_1_Temperate,
    # circularly wrapped difference in (-pi, pi]
    diff = atan2(sin(diff_raw), cos(diff_raw)),
    # optional: convert to weeks difference
    diff_weeks = diff / (2 * pi) * 52
  )

test %>%
  group_by(pat, mod) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_diff_rad   = as.numeric(mean(diff, na.rm = TRUE)),
    qlo_diff_rad    = as.numeric(quantile(diff, probs = 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)),
    qup_diff_rad    = as.numeric(quantile(diff, probs = 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)),
    mean_diff_weeks = as.numeric(mean(diff_weeks, na.rm = TRUE)),
    qlo_diff_weeks  = as.numeric(quantile(diff_weeks, probs = 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)),
    qup_diff_weeks  = as.numeric(quantile(diff_weeks, probs = 0.975, na.rm = TRUE))
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with(c("mean_", "qlo_", "qup_")), round, 2))
```
# For additional analyses
```{r}
add_samplescosine <- all_samplescosine %>%
  filter(is.na(included) | included == TRUE) %>%
  # Take best models from main analyses that have latitudinal change
  filter(mod %in% waiccomb_best$mod_best, dat == "s08")
```

```{r}

  # convert from weeks (0–52) to radians
  mutate(sam_phi_rad = sam_phi * (2 * pi / 52)) %>%
  select(-sam_phi) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = clu, values_from = sam_phi_rad, names_prefix = "clu_") %>%
  # raw difference in radians
  mutate(
    diff_raw = clu_3_Temperatesouth - clu_1_Temperate,
    # circularly wrapped difference in (-pi, pi]
    diff = atan2(sin(diff_raw), cos(diff_raw)),
    # optional: convert to weeks difference
    diff_weeks = diff / (2 * pi) * 52
  )

test %>%
  group_by(pat, mod) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_diff_rad   = as.numeric(mean(diff, na.rm = TRUE)),
    qlo_diff_rad    = as.numeric(quantile(diff, probs = 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)),
    qup_diff_rad    = as.numeric(quantile(diff, probs = 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)),
    mean_diff_weeks = as.numeric(mean(diff_weeks, na.rm = TRUE)),
    qlo_diff_weeks  = as.numeric(quantile(diff_weeks, probs = 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)),
    qup_diff_weeks  = as.numeric(quantile(diff_weeks, probs = 0.975, na.rm = TRUE))
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with(c("mean_", "qlo_", "qup_")), round, 2))
```
